name: VIX-spike RSI-washout reversion — daily capitulation long gated on an extreme fear print
rationale: MECHANISM: same forced-deleverage reversion as the 4h variant, but on a DAILY bar where the FRED VIX print is fresh (next-day availability aligns with a daily close) and the washout is read via rsi rather than bb_z — a different, momentum-based over-extension gauge. In a genuine macro fear spike crypto is dumped by price-insensitive VaR sellers and the daily RSI collapses; fading that oversold print after the fear peak captures the covering bounce. DISCONFIRMER: this must add OOS lift OVER a pure oversold-RSI crypto reversion baseline — if the VIX gate only trims trades without improving risk-adjusted return, the macro feature is decoration and it dies as a multiple-testing artifact. Also kill if the VIX floor is so high it fires <15 times (no effective N). Distinct from hh-macro-05 by bar_size AND by the over-extension gauge (rsi vs bb_z), not just a threshold twiddle.
catalyst: extreme VIX print into a daily oversold crypto washout
